sloka: एवं निरयगामी त्वं यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी ।न त्वां समभिभाषिष्ये ऽसद्वृत्तेष्वेव निर्णयः ।। ७.१५.२७ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ nirayagāmī tvaṁ yasya te matirīdṛśī ।na tvāṁ samabhibhāṣiṣye 'sadvṛtteṣveva nirṇayaḥ ।। 7.15.27 ॥

translations.english: You are destined for hell, as your intellect is of such a nature; I will not speak to you, for such is the judgment for those of bad conduct.
